text: The Patriots head to Buffalo on Sunday for a Week 4 showdown against Josh Allen and the Bills with a notably depleted secondary and defensive line, as Christian Gonzalez and Christian Barmore have both been ruled out due to shoulder injuries—forcing the team to lean on elevated practice squad members S Mike Brown and CB Kindle Vildor alongside whatever defensive schemes can compensate for the absences of two cornerstone defenders. The offensive side of the ball presents its own set of questions: WR Romeo Doubs, who signed a four-year deal in March, continues to search for his footing in the Patriots' system, while QB Drake Maye—currently sitting at 1-2 after early-season struggles—insists his right shoulder is fine and attributes his inconsistency to decision-making rather than physical limitations, a distinction that will face serious scrutiny against one of the league's premier defenses. Matt Pryor appears set to bolster the offensive line, and with seven questionable Patriots making the trip to western New York, the team will need to weather a laundry list of injury concerns while facing an Allen who has proven adept at bouncing back quickly from sloppy performances, creating what amounts to a daunting Week 4 test at 1 PM ET on Sunday.
